exceptions.mechanism: demonstrated routing discontinuity: the Metal pass takes the other side of reference router ties (slot 38 at 556 with an 8th/9th selection gap of 2.98e-08, slot 24 at 557 with a gap of 1.34e-07); forcing the reference's 8th picks reproduces Metal's logits to 9.1e-05 and 4.6e-05, and the corrupted state then persists
